28% of AI-led fresher job postings on foundit in July 2026 were AI/ML Engineer roles. In the same report, 41% of fresher roles paid Rs 3 to 5 LPA.

The AI jobs are real. So is the skill gap. Start with projects, not just certificates.

Source: foundit, July 2026, as reported by Masai School.
